title: MemeGo
tagline: Pokemon-Go but levelling up by capturing memecoins, distributed by memeocin owners to increase holder rate.
description: This is a Pokemon-Go style game where users walk around locations to spot and earn memecoins through their journey. Memecoin owners can airdrop their tokens to a smartcontract which will randomly distribute the memecoins across physical locations where users can walk to and collect them. A play/walk to earn game.
how_its_made: We used Privy wallet for easy user-login that allow us to scale across the web2 landscape.. We used Mapbox for  Map generation globally, AR to generate memecoins at the user's locations, React for the website front end, Arbitrum Stylus for the smart contractm and CCIP for the memecoin pricefeeds in the game.
